tools.name: findCustomer
tools.description: Search for a customer by name (works for both person and company customers) or entity ID. Returns up to 5 ranked matches, exact matches first. Use this to resolve a customer name to an internal ID before calling createSalesOrder. Check the exactMatch field on each result: if the top result is not an exact match, or if multiple results are returned, confirm the correct customer with the user before proceeding.

name.description: Customer name (full name for individuals, company name for organizations) or entity ID to search for. Partial matches are supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5, maximum 20.

tools.name: findItem
tools.description: Search for an inventory item by SKU or display name. Returns up to 5 ranked matches, exact matches first. Use this to resolve item names or SKUs to internal IDs before calling createSalesOrder. Check the exactMatch field on each result: if the top result is not an exact match, or if multiple results are returned, confirm the correct item with the user before proceeding. Only searches inventory items — non-inventory, service, and kit items are not included.

search.description: Item SKU or display name to search for. Partial matches are supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5, maximum 20.
